name: Model accuracy below 0.75
condition: Alert me when a live model's accuracy drops below 0.75

name: Score drift detected
condition: Alert me when a live model's input features drift more than 15% from training data

name: Data feed delayed
condition: Alert me when a scheduled upload is more than 1 hour late

name: Data feed upload failed
condition: Alert me when a scheduled upload fails

name: API error rate spike
condition: Alert me when API error rate is above 2% for 15 minutes

name: API latency spike
condition: Alert me when API p95 latency is above 300 ms for 15 minutes

name: Consent grant rate drop
condition: Alert me when an institution's consent grant rate drops below 70%

name: Fairness approval gap
condition: Alert me when the approval rate gap between any two groups is above 10 points

name: Repeated failed key attempts
condition: Alert me when more than 5 requests use a revoked or unknown API key within 10 minutes
